verdict.rationale: Square documents a List Payouts API and an official MCP server, so an agent can pull payout data programmatically. Official SDKs give access to the Square APIs. However, the evidence does not show a payments or transactions listing endpoint, and nothing shows reconciling daily takings into an external ledger. Missing for 10: documented transaction/payment listing API, payout-to-transaction reconciliation detail (fees, settlement entries), ledger/accounting export or integration, hands-on corroboration of an agent reconciliation workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp
